prompt: I want to code a game that allows multiplayer connection via the browser. How would you structure the project files?
response: For a browser-based multiplayer game, you can structure your project with a main HTML file that includes all the game logic and assets. Use JavaScript for handling the game state and user interactions. You can use a library like Socket.IO for real-time communication between clients and the server. Keep your game logic separate from the UI to make it easier to test and maintain.
